$comment: Every value is a fact about how that checkpoint was TRAINED, read off upstream's own scripts/<dataset>/train_topology.sh -- never guessed, and never defaulted from another checkpoint. `translate` is the one that differs (20/60/70 um), and FlyWire's 20.0 is absent from its train script because it is train_affinity.py's default. Everything under `config` is the task's own and is copied into the manifest opaquely -- `src/ml` never reads it, only `src/packs/seam` does. The incident behind this file is in docs/seam-plan.md; the rule is in describe().
